dataExport.accessDeniedDescription: You do not have permission to access the Data Export utility. This feature is restricted to system administrators.
dataExport.title: Data Export
dataExport.description: Export your personal data from the database.
dataExport.privacyDescription:
This tool strictly aggregates rows where the discord_id matches your authenticated session.
It ensures that you can review your footprint without exposing other users' data.
dataExport.exportZipDescription: Downloads a compressed ZIP containing JSON files for every database table where your user ID appears.
dataExport.exportJsonDescription: Downloads a single JSON file containing all your records structured by table name.
